title: The Lexicographical Permutation Rank
statement:
Given a string S containing distinct lowercase English letters, compute its 1-based lexicographical rank among all possible permutations of its letters.
Because the total number of permutations can be large, print the rank modulo 10^9 + 7.
inputFormat: A single string S of unique lowercase letters.
constraints:
1 <= len(S) <= 1000
All characters in S are distinct.

sampleCases.explanation: Permutations of "abc": abc (1), acb (2), bac (3), bca (4), cab (5), cba (6).
